!comment: Clang as the LLVM project releases it, the compiler of the Nix builds (nix/clang-release.nix): per Clang version of nixpkgs and per system, the release archive (github.com/llvm/llvm-project/releases), its SHA-256 as GitHub publishes it and Nix's hash of the one file kept from it, bin/clang-<major>. Update: scripts/clang-release-pin.sh <version>.
